description: VF11: representative EXPECTED wire shape for validate against a workspace with NO evaluation snapshot. This is a hand-authored contract fixture, not a runtime-observed capture: the reviewed BE extracts establish STATICALLY that the legacy IsEvaluated 409 gate was removed (StartScenarioValidationCommand accepts a null snapshot and resolves the resource-selector map on the fly; the exception mapper maps no evaluation-required conflict), so the DOCUMENTED contract for an unevaluated workspace is the normal external 202 (validations/latest Location + default Retry-After 10) rather than a 409. It encodes that workspace evaluation is advisory in the inspected code, not a proven end-to-end runtime response.
context: Workspace ws-unevaluated has never been evaluated (null discovery/evaluation snapshot).
